semiconductor_relevance: High — WONIK Corporation supplies critical measurement and inspection equipment for the semiconductor industry.
summary: WONIK Corporation is a leading supplier of advanced measurement and inspection equipment for the semiconductor industry, including products for wafer and reticle monitoring. They provide high-quality tools for particle detection and gas mass spectrometry, supporting the manufacturing processes of domestic companies in Korea.
capabilities: Kanomax Infi-TOF for gas mass spectrometry
Kanomax FMT STPC3 for UPW liquid particle measurement
Enmont CT100 for nanoparticle detection in gas

regional_presence.Korea: WONIK Corporation is based in Korea and supplies equipment to domestic semiconductor manufacturers.
